status: Implemented and qualified for the named runtime receiving boundaries: 1192 distinct tests passed, 18 existing ignores; signals-only, Canvas Wasm and embedding builds passed

authority.kernel: GraphInputKey is allocated at graph construction and existing structural/content/site/visit bump boundaries. Clones preserve keys; edited forks get distinct input versions even when numeric counters match. Fresh materialization gets another source.
authority.shared_models: ChannelRegistry keys graph and physics facts by these source-qualified inputs. Binding a different source drops held values without resetting producer counts; off-thread community offers must match the live graph key.
authority.Meaning: Content input observation advances the existing request generation before freshness tests or actor draining, invalidating pending jobs, accepted snapshots and failed-run tags from replaced inputs while retaining engine/settings.
authority.Canvas_host: Captured layout source includes the actual Canvas owner, replacement epoch and structural input. Transition installation revalidates it; detached StopReturn carries the same source. Cancellation reports cancellation rather than a landed arrangement.

fixed_bugs: Equal numeric revisions previously allowed one materialized graph or divergent candidate to reuse another graph's signal values.
Equal content counters could call an old Meaning snapshot fresh after wholesale ingest; source-qualified content observation invalidates it before receiving.
Delayed arrangement transitions could land on a removed/recreated node or another Canvas sharing the same Graph clone.
Detached StopReturn previously resolved bare slots against the receiving graph before any source admission.
Weighted edge, topology/physics, analytic memo, gloss and affinity-install caches now use the same kernel input boundary instead of colliding graph-local counters.
Rule-face batch epochs now retire with ended surface memberships, including same-UUID recreation, without changing surviving member/action IDs.
ordinary_edit_contract: GraphInputKey reads allocate nothing. Structural keys survive title-only edits, preserving topology cache run counts; content keys advance only at the existing content invalidation boundary.
Ordinary clones, metadata refresh and surviving member/action identities remain continuous. Independently edited candidates cannot collide through equal counter values.
Authored UUID rosters, override ownership, durable IDs and snapshot schemas remain separate; runtime keys and Canvas ownership receipts are not serialized.
write_path_inventory: Graph::new creates one source shared by its four runtime input domains; bump_revision/bump_content_revision/bump_url_grouping_revision/bump_visit_revision advance the corresponding domain.

Residency, snapshot loading and legacy journal replacement materialize a candidate graph with its own source. Their existing explicit numeric counter assignments do not turn a fresh source into an old one.
Graph::clone copies keys until a mutator advances its affected domain. No mutable pointer identity or read-time identity allocation is used.
api_receiving: StopReturn is captured with StopReturn::new(canvas, from, to, duration_ms); its source is private. All in-repo construction paths were updated.
PhysicsViewKey.structure and ChannelRegistry community offers now take GraphInputKey. The shared registry owns the source comparison; Canvas does not maintain a second graph input allocator.

ArrangementTransition::advance remains a schedule sampler. In-tree Graphshell installation uses advance_arrangement, which checks the captured source. External direct raw-position installers still need explicit admission.

remaining_migrations.owner: External host result and provider request admission
remaining_migrations.gap: Bare position/UUID/content/affinity setters express current direct edits. They cannot identify an out-of-order network or embedding reply, or revoke a detached external caller. Layout source admission does not capture every recipe/viewport/policy request parameter.
remaining_migrations.done_condition: Carry actual owner, captured input version and request identity from each dispatch to its exact installer, including superseded requests on the same live member. Replace unchecked external sampler/raw-position installation at concrete consumers.

remaining_migrations.owner: Graphshell async product and fetch ownership
remaining_migrations.gap: Product completions reconcile a returned app/session before Canvas metadata receiving; the legacy direct metadata helper and provider-specific fetch cancellation/admission need separate source/request receiving. Parallel fetch-actor WIP is preserved and excluded from this patch and isolated acceptance.
remaining_migrations.done_condition: Trace each real completion transaction and provider reply through dispatch, owner/head admission, backend outcome and projection install. Qualify any fetch actor changes in their own lane.

remaining_migrations.owner: Source-specific assertions, fields, authored curation and durable history
remaining_migrations.gap: Graph runtime input versions do not define link/field/assertion ABA, authored Fold/Forme lifetime policy, snapshot transaction authority or durable replay completion.
remaining_migrations.done_condition: Receive each source's own replacement/rollback and durable installation rules without converting runtime tokens into persisted authority.

remaining_migrations.gap: Custom producer/action reassignments, external consumer pins, guest namespaces/selection ingress, full-leaf raster/intrinsic sizing, terminal actor outcomes and headed AT/physical handoff remain independently open.
remaining_migrations.done_condition: Continue owner-specific producer, supplier and platform gates.
